text: Rep. John Vander Woude MEDICAID EXPANSION You’ve been a vocal opponent of Medicaid expansion and introduced a bill to repeal it in its entirety, Walk me through your concerns? (Money) -As of December, IDHW reports about 90,000 people are on the expansion plan. Are you concerned about them losing health care? -Without Medicaid expansion, what do we do with people who are in the gap? How does this work? There will be more ER visits, more expensive visits. -Medicaid Expansion passed with 61% of the vote, what would you say to the voters who supported it if it’s repealed. (Worth note: He won his election by 65% of the vote) PROVIDER CONTRACTS You also introduced a bill to make provider agreements have a one-year duration. What are your concerns around that? DOJ COMPLAINT Department of Justice notified Idaho that it is in violation of the Americans with Disabilities Act because of how it administers its long-term care system for adults with physical disabilities. The notification is new, but the problems are not. They cite issues such as the state’s limited community services and over-reliance on institutional settings. Do you know of any bills related to community-care settings coming? FOSTER IDHW has put a major focus on the foster care system this year. What do you expect to see? How do you measure success with the foster care system? ABORTION Do you anticipate any bills regarding IVF or changes to existing abortion law? CHAIRMANSHIP What are you keeping an eye on coming through your committee this year?
